caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with three large drawers, each having two round wooden knobs as handles. The dresser is rendered in shades of reddish-brown, representing wood grain with lighter and darker streaks to illustrate texture and depth. Decorative patterns run along the edges of the drawer fronts, top panel, and base, forming a continuous border that is visually distinct from the rest of the wood paneling. The dresser also features a raised, slanted backboard at the top, with its own matching decorative border and two small holes, possibly for mounting or attaching an accessory. The base of the dresser is elevated slightly with scalloped cutouts on either side. The entire drawing is set against an off-white, blank background.
title: Sewing Cabinet
